# Corewood

Type: Wood | Internal ID: RoundLog | Source: Pine | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Corewood is a different type of wood used in early building and crafting recipes. The main benefit of Corewood compared with common Wood is a greater support factor, which allows construction of larger and taller buildings.

## Availability

• Chop Pine Trees found in the Black Forest, or grown from Pine cones with a Cultivator.
• Can be cut with a Stone axe.

### Smelting

• Corewood can be used with Charcoal Kiln to produce Coal, which can be used to smelt ores in a Smelter.

Categorias: Wood, Materials
